name: NCRD Overlays 0.1.68
body:
NCRD Overlays 0.1.68

Install the Setup EXE once. From 0.1.2 onward, use Updates > Download & restart. Settings are retained; the previous app version is kept for rollback.

The win-x64 ZIP is the verified in-app update payload. This release is separate from the SimHub plugin channel.

## 0.1.68
- Spotter keeps the player fixed and moves associated opponents forward/backward using lap-distance telemetry, with smoothing and start/finish wrapping. More vertical space shows overlap movement. Lateral spacing remains indicative because iRacing does not expose opponent XY coordinates; ambiguous side identities fall back to overlap indicators.

## 0.1.67
- Added background-saturation controls to every overlay with a background, including Fuel Calculator, Telemetry, Engineer and Flagbox. All backgrounds start at 50% on this update; subsequent changes remain saved. Spotter remains fully transparent.

## 0.1.66
- Added Wind Radar: NCRD-green rotating compass with wind speed and cardinal direction, selectable KM/H or MPH.
- Added background-saturation controls to Trackmap and Wind Radar, including Trackmap header/footer backgrounds.

## 0.1.65
- Added Trackmap with Static and player-following Dynamic views, background opacity, saved learned layouts, and independent three-slot headers/footers for track, weather and session data.
- Relative driver names now turn blue for lapped cars and red for cars a lap ahead, with start/finish crossing protection.

## 0.1.64
- Flagbox now uses rectangular flag panels instead of waving flag vectors.
- Added Spotter: transparent side-overlap markers with adjustable height and player/opponent colours. Appears only for active alongside traffic; supports cars on both sides and two cars on one side.

## 0.1.63
- Engineer: white rival session-fastest lap notifications with driver name and time; orange-yellow class leader / driver ahead / driver behind pit-entry alerts, each independently selectable. Duplicate leader/ahead notices are combined.

## 0.1.62
- Added Flagbox: rounded gradient flag blocks with individual flag switches, independent width/height (200 × 200 default), opacity and size controls. Highest-priority active flag wins; idle alerts hide automatically.

## 0.1.61
- Engineer lap times use title-sized PS Clubs, with ordinary-lap deltas underneath.
- Personal-best and session-fastest cards omit deltas.
- Left/Right notification alignment mirrors text, accent line and gradient; reflected in the settings preview.

## 0.1.60
- New Engineer popup overlay with colour-coded fuel, weather, track-wetness, penalty, repair and race-flag notifications.
- Configurable lap reports: every lap, personal best, session fastest or off; time and delta to prior best.
- Individual alert switches, duration, opacity and size controls; urgent messages take priority and idle overlay is invisible.

## 0.1.59
- Moved EXIT to the top right immediately after Account, removing it from the footer.

## 0.1.58
- Class driver count and SOF now sit directly beside the class name, with a consistent 12 px gap.

## 0.1.57
- Leaderboard driver-line selection moved into its main settings page with a rendered drag-and-drop order preview.
- Full name / first-initial name formatting with First Last / F. Last preview.
- Class headers show individual class SOF and a vector helmet beside driver count.
- Player class only aligned left; leaderboard header control renamed Header Items.

## 0.1.56
- Grouped Telemetry switches into rounded Graph and Misc panels, retaining the two-column layout.

## 0.1.55
- Optional NCRD-green gradient flashes behind the gear on shifts, fading over 450 ms.
- Gradient follows gear size and element order, respects background opacity, and does not trigger on initial connection.

## 0.1.54
- Added adjustable gear size. New wheel size defaults to 100 px and input meters to 20 px; existing saved sizes are preserved.
- Replaced ordering buttons with a rendered drag-and-drop telemetry layout preview, insertion highlight and keyboard reordering.

## 0.1.53
- Reserved right-hand spacing on all settings pages so scrollbars remain clear of controls.

## 0.1.52
- Optional redline gear blink uses the car shift-light RPM threshold.
- Optional gear indicator and configurable left-to-right element ordering.
- Separate wheel size and input meter width controls for Telemetry.
- New detailed GT wheel vector with open grips, display cutout, button and rotary details.
- Layout reserves space for the selected sizes without changing graph time scale.

## 0.1.51
- Telemetry: individual throttle, brake, steering and blue clutch graph toggles; removed graph legend.
- Width control extends visible history at a consistent time scale; adjustable graph thickness and opacity retained.
- Optional original GT or Round steering wheel follows actual steering angle.

## 0.1.50
- Add a Telemetry overlay and settings tab with 5–60 seconds of history, background opacity, 1–6 px line thickness and optional vertical throttle/brake/clutch meters.
- Throttle is green, brakes red, steering white at 30% opacity, and recorded ABS-active brake segments yellow. Live input history is bounded and clears on telemetry resets.
- Telemetry shares the existing visibility, locking, layout persistence and global shortcuts; enable it from Home.

## 0.1.49
- Give action buttons and their hover highlights the same rounded corners as menu buttons, consistently in both themes.

## 0.1.48
- Left-align the rendered logo with the sidebar and status text in both themes instead of centring it inside the image area.

## 0.1.47
- Align Demo mode, Unlock Overlays and Reset positions together at the far right of the top toolbar, in that order.

## 0.1.46
- Move the Auto / Force show / Force hide dropdown from the top toolbar to General Settings.

## 0.1.45
- Use white app menu labels and headings with neutral-grey PS Mono subtitles. Paper uses dark text for contrast. Overlay telemetry colours are unchanged.

## 0.1.44
- Redesign sliders with wide rounded tracks, rounded green handles and labels above the track with right-aligned value badges.

## 0.1.43
- Give selected sidebar tabs a subtle green gradient and illuminated edge, with a matching selection treatment in dropdown menus for both themes.

## 0.1.42
- Setting Background Saturation and Line Divider Style to zero now produces one continuous dark-grey background across headers, footers and all driver rows.
- Apply Background Saturation to leaderboard class-header backgrounds as well as the main header, footer and driver-row backgrounds. Class-label colours stay unchanged.

## 0.1.41
- Give slider knobs the NCRD green accent in both themes.
- Use consistent on/off pill switches for all checkbox options, including overlay settings, Demo mode, temperature units and password visibility.

## 0.1.40
- Move keyboard shortcuts into Settings with click-to-assign controls, conflict detection and saved custom assignments. Existing shortcuts remain the defaults.
- Remove keyboard shortcut and borderless/windowed-mode notes from the footer.

## 0.1.39
- Align the app toolbar, sidebar, page panels, settings controls and footer with consistent spacing. Home now uses the same panel style as every settings tab.
- Move the Dark / Paper theme selector to General Settings.

## 0.1.38
- Apply background opacity uniformly to headers, footers, driver rows, class bands, pit details and fuel warning backgrounds. Text, icons and indicators remain fully legible.

## 0.1.37
- Add Line Divider Style and Background Saturation sliders for Relative and Leaderboard, saved independently.
- Blend from a solid driver-row background to alternating row tones, and from dark neutral grey to the existing purple tint.
- Preserve driver text, flags, class colours and player highlighting. Defaults retain the existing appearance.
- Replace Lamborghini's bull-only mark with a full white shield vector on transparent background.

## 0.1.36
- Add a general SETTINGS page directly above UPDATES in the left menu.
- First setting: Keep overlays visible outside the cockpit. Enabled by default to preserve spectator visibility.
- Turning it off hides overlays outside the car in Auto mode. Force show/hide takes priority; Demo mode remains available for setup.
- Save the preference across restarts and updates; match Dark and Paper themes.

## 0.1.35
- Add Auto / Force show / Force hide overlay visibility modes in the control panel and tray menu.
- Global Ctrl+Alt+H toggles force show/hide, including while the control panel is hidden.
- Force show overrides simulator-disconnect hiding while respecting per-overlay switches and sign-in access. Auto is restored on app launch.
- Includes edit-bar LOCK OVERLAYS buttons and saved-position protection.

## 0.1.34
- Add a LOCK OVERLAYS button inside each green edit bar; clicking any one locks every overlay.
- Button scales with the overlay and does not change its dimensions or placement.
- Includes saved-position protection from automatic window recovery.

## 0.1.33
- Prevent automatic window relocation and off-screen recovery from overwriting saved overlay positions.
- Restore saved positions whenever overlays reappear; only intentional dragging or Reset positions changes the saved layout.
- Check screen visibility using native monitor coordinates, avoiding mixed display-scaling comparisons.
- Add Fuel Calculator position reload, reconnect and temporary off-screen recovery checks.

## 0.1.32
- Yellow fuel banner counts down as available fuel crosses each whole-lap threshold.
- Uses the live average fuel estimate: 4.9 laps displays 5 LAPS OF FUEL; 4.0 displays 4 LAPS OF FUEL.
- Below one lap it switches to PIT on red, in either header or footer placement.

## 0.1.31
- Yellow low-fuel banner reads 5 LAPS OF FUEL below five laps remaining.
- Critical banner reads PIT on red below one lap remaining.
- Applies to either Header or Footer placement; Off still suppresses notifications.

## 0.1.30
- Hide all overlays automatically when the simulator disconnects; restore enabled overlays when telemetry reconnects.
- Preserve visibility preferences and keep the control panel accessible. Demo mode continues to display previews.
- Restore leaderboard column headings to their previous left alignment.

## 0.1.29
- Session lap headers update from the overall leader while spectating, rather than a frozen local-driver lap counter.
- Keep the local lap display when driving and cap spectator laps at the race distance.
- Includes spectator iRating fix, centred leaderboard headings and white McLaren speedmark.

## 0.1.28
- Use the standalone white McLaren speedmark, with no wordmark or background.
- Includes live spectator iRating estimate fix and centred leaderboard column titles.

## 0.1.27
- Fix iRating estimates being disabled while spectating an official live race with replay playback active.
- Use session mode to distinguish live-server playback from saved replays; saved replay estimates remain disabled even when paused.
- Centre leaderboard column titles above their columns.

## 0.1.26
- Fix iRating estimates disappearing for a whole class when the session roster includes unclassified cars with no race position.
- Keep classified retired/disconnected drivers in the projection and validate the ranked field before calculating.
- Add regression checks for extra unclassified entries, missing/duplicate positions, and parsed official live races.

## 0.1.25
- Compact iRating rounds down to tenths of a K, except within 10 points of the next hundred.
- Examples: 4751 / 4789 -> 4.7K; 4790 -> 4.8K. Full ratings remain exact.

## 0.1.24
- Independent iRating format selectors for Relative and Leaderboard: 0000 or 0.0K.
- Full ratings remain the default. Compact values retain licence colours and centred boxes.

## 0.1.23
- Subtle hover highlights on sidebar menu items and app buttons in Dark and Paper.
- Hover tint preserves the selected menu state and blue update-available indicator.

## 0.1.22
- Replace the fuel calculator PIT badge with a full-width PIT banner.
- Choose Header (default), Footer or Off in Fuel Calculator settings; selection is saved.
- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.
- Reserve banner space to keep overlay dimensions and data positions stable as alerts change.

## 0.1.21

- Add a saved Dark / Paper app-theme dropdown beside Account. Paper uses light-grey surfaces, charcoal typography, square cards and thin borders inspired by the supplied reference.
- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Rebuild the app, tray and installer icon from the original transparent rabbit artwork; remove the opaque white square at all packaged icon sizes.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

## 0.1.19

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

- Distinguish actual black-flag penalties with a white X over the black rectangle on both driver overlays. Slowdown/furled warnings remain a plain black rectangle in Relative; an actual penalty takes precedence if both flags are present.
- Includes restored TRACK / AIR text and plain C/F units.

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.
- Includes the restored TRACK / AIR labels with plain C/F units from 0.1.16.

## 0.1.16

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

## 0.1.15

- Replace TRACK and AIR text in overlay header/footer bands with the supplied road and sun graphics, tinted lavender. Keep icon/value pairs aligned together in each slot.
- Remove degree symbols from temperature values: 25.0C / 77.0F.
- Includes the race-only pit lap/time row extensions from 0.1.14.

## 0.1.14

- Add race-only pit details extending from the right of each applicable leaderboard row: pit-entry lap (L12) and total pit-lane time (00:34.7). Time runs while in pit lane and freezes on exit; the latest stop remains until the next stop/session reset.
- Keep the extension transparent for other rows and remove its width completely when no displayed driver has a recorded stop. Add a Pit stop details visibility option.
- Record only observed pit entries after the race starts; do not fabricate stops for mid-pit joins, pre-race staging or missing telemetry.

## 0.1.13

- Reduce all fuel calculator numeric values and the Next Pit timer by 10%, keeping title sizes and character spacing proportions.

- Highlight the sidebar UPDATES button in blue with white text when startup or manual update checks find a newer app release. Restore normal styling when a successful check reports up to date; failed checks preserve the last known state.

## 0.1.12

- Add an optional white manufacturer-logo column immediately after position changes on the leaderboard, including existing layouts. Driver line items can hide or reorder it.
- Identify makes from each car’s SDK path/name, with a short label fallback for makes without bundled artwork and a dash for unknown cars.
- Includes the fuel spacing, default Last 5 visibility and row colours from 0.1.11.

## 0.1.11

- Slightly increase character spacing on all fuel calculator values, retaining PS Clubs and keeping long values within their columns.
- Default Last 5 to off for new settings; preserve saved row choices.
- Use spring green for Last and lavender for Last 5.

## 0.1.10

- Remember terms acceptance across restarts and updates, including earlier accepted terms. Fresh interactive installer acceptance is recognized by the app; silent installs still require in-app acceptance.
- Keep the sign-in/signup dialog open until authenticated, with an explicit Exit NCRD action; show it again after sign-out or account revocation. Saved valid sessions still restore automatically.
- Practice/qualifying leaderboard gap is the best-lap difference to the fastest valid lap in that class; track lap counts cannot override it. Race gap remains time/laps behind the class leader based on track progress.

## 0.1.9

- Require sign-in before overlays display; save encrypted sessions across restarts and hide overlays on sign-out or failed account verification.
- Add VISIBLE beside each switch, aligned with overlay titles; increase settings row spacing and panel padding.
- Right-align leaderboard car numbers.
- Move Account beside the version number and UPDATES to the bottom of the left navigation.
- Includes player OUT, fixed PS Clubs gap characters, footer links and title-bar changes from 0.1.8.

## 0.1.8

- Use dedicated player pit-road and lap telemetry for the player OUT indicator, with pit-stall fallback when needed; preserve opponent detection.
- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.
- Remove the top-left title-bar wording from the main control panel.
- Add bottom-right Discord and Website buttons.

## 0.1.7

- Correct the contracting company in the installer and in-app terms to No Content Racing Division Inc.
- Update the Windows installer publisher and request acceptance of the corrected agreement.

## 0.1.6

- Improve account form contrast: readable checkbox labels and dark email/password fields. Includes all 0.1.5 updates below.

## 0.1.5

- Relative gaps use PS Clubs with tight signs and right alignment beside delta bars.
- Restore OUT detection after pit/garage frames with unavailable lap progress; retain the plugin-style yellow badge even with Stint hidden.
- Fuel headings enlarged 20%; LAPS IN RACE aligned with the second column.
- Independent Best Lap and Last Lap format selectors, preserving existing preferences.
- Green bottom-right window resize grip.
- Shared NCRD account sign-in, signup, email verification, password reset, Google/Discord, encrypted Remember me and linked installation management. Verified users no longer need an owner allowlist entry; explicitly disabled accounts remain blocked.
- Installer terms checkbox and versioned in-app acceptance for existing users; Terms available from the control panel.

# 0.1.4

- Add HOME, RELATIVE, LEADERBOARD and FUEL CALCULATOR navigation. Home has three synced visibility switches; each overlay has its own settings page.

- Remove the always-on-top explanatory line from the control panel and keep the control panel at normal window priority; only overlay windows stay topmost.

- Blend the main window and dialog title bars into their dark backgrounds; add matching minimise, maximise/restore and close buttons while retaining native drag and resize behaviour.
- Includes all 0.1.3 formatting, OUT badge, 2-pixel snapping and selectable lap-time format changes below.

# 0.1.3

- Match plugin header/footer typography and colour: PS Clubs, lavender #C8BEF5, with the original #28252F band background.

- Add a saved Leaderboard lap time format selector for both Best and Last: 00.0 or 00:00.0, with wider columns for minutes.

- Relative gaps use right-aligned PS Mono One, with signs directly adjacent to the numbers and no added spaces.
- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.
- Change overlay placement snapping to 2 physical pixels.
- Match the SimHub OUT badge: half-transparent yellow fill, yellow outline, dark centred text, rounded corners and the same dimensions as iRating boxes. Preserve the badge when Stint is hidden.

# 0.1.2

- Add Updates page: download, SHA-256 verification, restart, previous-version backup and startup-failure rollback.
- Check for available app releases at startup; use a separate GitHub app release channel.
- Rename the application NCRD Overlays; remove Standalone Beta and the tagline.
- Remove the tilde prefix from Relative gaps.
- Centre iRating digits horizontally and vertically inside their boxes on both overlays.

# 0.1.1 beta

- Fixed edit strip increasing overlay dimensions; keep window dimensions during drag, snap to a 10-pixel physical grid.
- Restored fastest-to-slowest class ordering, top three other-class rows, and player-class top three plus configurable context.
- Keep relative opponents visible without timing; use root SDK estimated lap pace; read lap times from live arrays, scalar player telemetry and session results.
- Restore white licence-coloured iRating boxes, 00.0 best/last laps, class-colour left strips, neutral/green/red right delta bars and compact SimHub-style bands.
- Add selectable Relative header/footer and Leaderboard header items, independent temperature units and visibility.
- Remove automatic status footers.
- Add optional estimated iRating gain/loss beside leaderboard iRating.
- Add supplied rabbit application, tray and installer icon.

Self-contained Windows x64 build. 25 fuel and 69 core regression checks passed. Windows desktop/iRacing acceptance remains to be run.

- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.

- Add a saved Dark / Paper app-theme dropdown beside Account. Paper uses light-grey surfaces, charcoal typography, square cards and thin borders inspired by the supplied reference.
- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Rebuild the app, tray and installer icon from the original transparent rabbit artwork; remove the opaque white square at all packaged icon sizes.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

## 0.1.19

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

- Distinguish actual black-flag penalties with a white X over the black rectangle on both driver overlays. Slowdown/furled warnings remain a plain black rectangle in Relative; an actual penalty takes precedence if both flags are present.
- Includes restored TRACK / AIR text and plain C/F units.

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.
- Includes the restored TRACK / AIR labels with plain C/F units from 0.1.16.

## 0.1.16

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

## 0.1.15

- Replace TRACK and AIR text in overlay header/footer bands with the supplied road and sun graphics, tinted lavender. Keep icon/value pairs aligned together in each slot.
- Remove degree symbols from temperature values: 25.0C / 77.0F.
- Includes the race-only pit lap/time row extensions from 0.1.14.

## 0.1.14

- Add race-only pit details extending from the right of each applicable leaderboard row: pit-entry lap (L12) and total pit-lane time (00:34.7). Time runs while in pit lane and freezes on exit; the latest stop remains until the next stop/session reset.
- Keep the extension transparent for other rows and remove its width completely when no displayed driver has a recorded stop. Add a Pit stop details visibility option.
- Record only observed pit entries after the race starts; do not fabricate stops for mid-pit joins, pre-race staging or missing telemetry.

## 0.1.13

- Reduce all fuel calculator numeric values and the Next Pit timer by 10%, keeping title sizes and character spacing proportions.

- Highlight the sidebar UPDATES button in blue with white text when startup or manual update checks find a newer app release. Restore normal styling when a successful check reports up to date; failed checks preserve the last known state.

## 0.1.12

- Add an optional white manufacturer-logo column immediately after position changes on the leaderboard, including existing layouts. Driver line items can hide or reorder it.
- Identify makes from each car’s SDK path/name, with a short label fallback for makes without bundled artwork and a dash for unknown cars.
- Includes the fuel spacing, default Last 5 visibility and row colours from 0.1.11.

## 0.1.11

- Slightly increase character spacing on all fuel calculator values, retaining PS Clubs and keeping long values within their columns.

- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.

- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.

- Added background-saturation controls to Trackmap and Wind Radar, including Trackmap header/footer backgrounds.

## 0.1.65
- Added Trackmap with Static and player-following Dynamic views, background opacity, saved learned layouts, and independent three-slot headers/footers for track, weather and session data.
- Relative driver names now turn blue for lapped cars and red for cars a lap ahead, with start/finish crossing protection.

## 0.1.64

## 0.1.48
- Left-align the rendered logo with the sidebar and status text in both themes instead of centring it inside the image area.

## 0.1.47

## 0.1.44

## 0.1.43

- Reserved right-hand spacing on all settings pages so scrollbars remain clear of controls.

## 0.1.52
- Optional redline gear blink uses the car shift-light RPM threshold.
- Optional gear indicator and configurable left-to-right element ordering.
- Separate wheel size and input meter width controls for Telemetry.
- New detailed GT wheel vector with open grips, display cutout, button and rotary details.
- Layout reserves space for the selected sizes without changing graph time scale.

## 0.1.51
- Telemetry: individual throttle, brake, steering and blue clutch graph toggles; removed graph legend.
- Width control extends visible history at a consistent time scale; adjustable graph thickness and opacity retained.
- Optional original GT or Round steering wheel follows actual steering angle.

- Add a Telemetry overlay and settings tab with 5–60 seconds of history, background opacity, 1–6 px line thickness and optional vertical throttle/brake/clutch meters.

- Give action buttons and their hover highlights the same rounded corners as menu buttons, consistently in both themes.

## 0.1.48
- Left-align the rendered logo with the sidebar and status text in both themes instead of centring it inside the image area.

## 0.1.47
- Align Demo mode, Unlock Overlays and Reset positions together at the far right of the top toolbar, in that order.

## 0.1.46
- Move the Auto / Force show / Force hide dropdown from the top toolbar to General Settings.

## 0.1.45
- Use white app menu labels and headings with neutral-grey PS Mono subtitles. Paper uses dark text for contrast. Overlay telemetry colours are unchanged.

## 0.1.44
- Redesign sliders with wide rounded tracks, rounded green handles and labels above the track with right-aligned value badges.

## 0.1.43
- Give selected sidebar tabs a subtle green gradient and illuminated edge, with a matching selection treatment in dropdown menus for both themes.

## 0.1.42
- Setting Background Saturation and Line Divider Style to zero now produces one continuous dark-grey background across headers, footers and all driver rows.

## 0.1.41
- Give slider knobs the NCRD green accent in both themes.
- Use consistent on/off pill switches for all checkbox options, including overlay settings, Demo mode, temperature units and password visibility.

## 0.1.40
- Move keyboard shortcuts into Settings with click-to-assign controls, conflict detection and saved custom assignments. Existing shortcuts remain the defaults.
- Remove keyboard shortcut and borderless/windowed-mode notes from the footer.

## 0.1.39
- Align the app toolbar, sidebar, page panels, settings controls and footer with consistent spacing. Home now uses the same panel style as every settings tab.
- Move the Dark / Paper theme selector to General Settings.

## 0.1.38
- Apply background opacity uniformly to headers, footers, driver rows, class bands, pit details and fuel warning backgrounds. Text, icons and indicators remain fully legible.

## 0.1.37
- Add Line Divider Style and Background Saturation sliders for Relative and Leaderboard, saved independently.
- Blend from a solid driver-row background to alternating row tones, and from dark neutral grey to the existing purple tint.
- Preserve driver text, flags, class colours and player highlighting. Defaults retain the existing appearance.
- Replace Lamborghini's bull-only mark with a full white shield vector on transparent background.

## 0.1.36
- Add a general SETTINGS page directly above UPDATES in the left menu.
- First setting: Keep overlays visible outside the cockpit. Enabled by default to preserve spectator visibility.

- Save the preference across restarts and updates; match Dark and Paper themes.

## 0.1.35

- Global Ctrl+Alt+H toggles force show/hide, including while the control panel is hidden.
- Force show overrides simulator-disconnect hiding while respecting per-overlay switches and sign-in access. Auto is restored on app launch.
- Includes edit-bar LOCK OVERLAYS buttons and saved-position protection.

## 0.1.34
- Add a LOCK OVERLAYS button inside each green edit bar; clicking any one locks every overlay.
- Button scales with the overlay and does not change its dimensions or placement.
- Includes saved-position protection from automatic window recovery.

## 0.1.33
- Prevent automatic window relocation and off-screen recovery from overwriting saved overlay positions.
- Restore saved positions whenever overlays reappear; only intentional dragging or Reset positions changes the saved layout.
- Check screen visibility using native monitor coordinates, avoiding mixed display-scaling comparisons.
- Add Fuel Calculator position reload, reconnect and temporary off-screen recovery checks.

- Yellow fuel banner counts down as available fuel crosses each whole-lap threshold.

## 0.1.31
- Yellow low-fuel banner reads 5 LAPS OF FUEL below five laps remaining.
- Critical banner reads PIT on red below one lap remaining.

- Hide all overlays automatically when the simulator disconnects; restore enabled overlays when telemetry reconnects.
- Preserve visibility preferences and keep the control panel accessible. Demo mode continues to display previews.
- Restore leaderboard column headings to their previous left alignment.

## 0.1.29
- Session lap headers update from the overall leader while spectating, rather than a frozen local-driver lap counter.
- Keep the local lap display when driving and cap spectator laps at the race distance.
- Includes spectator iRating fix, centred leaderboard headings and white McLaren speedmark.

## 0.1.28
- Use the standalone white McLaren speedmark, with no wordmark or background.
- Includes live spectator iRating estimate fix and centred leaderboard column titles.

## 0.1.27
- Fix iRating estimates being disabled while spectating an official live race with replay playback active.
- Use session mode to distinguish live-server playback from saved replays; saved replay estimates remain disabled even when paused.
- Centre leaderboard column titles above their columns.

## 0.1.26
- Fix iRating estimates disappearing for a whole class when the session roster includes unclassified cars with no race position.
- Keep classified retired/disconnected drivers in the projection and validate the ranked field before calculating.
- Add regression checks for extra unclassified entries, missing/duplicate positions, and parsed official live races.

## 0.1.25
- Compact iRating rounds down to tenths of a K, except within 10 points of the next hundred.
- Examples: 4751 / 4789 -> 4.7K; 4790 -> 4.8K. Full ratings remain exact.

## 0.1.24
- Independent iRating format selectors for Relative and Leaderboard: 0000 or 0.0K.
- Full ratings remain the default. Compact values retain licence colours and centred boxes.

## 0.1.23
- Subtle hover highlights on sidebar menu items and app buttons in Dark and Paper.
- Hover tint preserves the selected menu state and blue update-available indicator.

## 0.1.22
- Replace the fuel calculator PIT badge with a full-width PIT banner.
- Choose Header (default), Footer or Off in Fuel Calculator settings; selection is saved.
- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.
- Reserve banner space to keep overlay dimensions and data positions stable as alerts change.

## 0.1.21

- Add a saved Dark / Paper app-theme dropdown beside Account. Paper uses light-grey surfaces, charcoal typography, square cards and thin borders inspired by the supplied reference.
- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Rebuild the app, tray and installer icon from the original transparent rabbit artwork; remove the opaque white square at all packaged icon sizes.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

## 0.1.19

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

- Includes restored TRACK / AIR text and plain C/F units.

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.

## 0.1.16

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

## 0.1.15

- Replace TRACK and AIR text in overlay header/footer bands with the supplied road and sun graphics, tinted lavender. Keep icon/value pairs aligned together in each slot.
- Remove degree symbols from temperature values: 25.0C / 77.0F.
- Includes the race-only pit lap/time row extensions from 0.1.14.

## 0.1.14

- Add race-only pit details extending from the right of each applicable leaderboard row: pit-entry lap (L12) and total pit-lane time (00:34.7). Time runs while in pit lane and freezes on exit; the latest stop remains until the next stop/session reset.

- Record only observed pit entries after the race starts; do not fabricate stops for mid-pit joins, pre-race staging or missing telemetry.

## 0.1.13

- Reduce all fuel calculator numeric values and the Next Pit timer by 10%, keeping title sizes and character spacing proportions.

- Highlight the sidebar UPDATES button in blue with white text when startup or manual update checks find a newer app release. Restore normal styling when a successful check reports up to date; failed checks preserve the last known state.

## 0.1.12

- Add an optional white manufacturer-logo column immediately after position changes on the leaderboard, including existing layouts. Driver line items can hide or reorder it.
- Identify makes from each car’s SDK path/name, with a short label fallback for makes without bundled artwork and a dash for unknown cars.
- Includes the fuel spacing, default Last 5 visibility and row colours from 0.1.11.

## 0.1.11

- Slightly increase character spacing on all fuel calculator values, retaining PS Clubs and keeping long values within their columns.
- Default Last 5 to off for new settings; preserve saved row choices.
- Use spring green for Last and lavender for Last 5.

## 0.1.10

- Remember terms acceptance across restarts and updates, including earlier accepted terms. Fresh interactive installer acceptance is recognized by the app; silent installs still require in-app acceptance.
- Keep the sign-in/signup dialog open until authenticated, with an explicit Exit NCRD action; show it again after sign-out or account revocation. Saved valid sessions still restore automatically.
- Practice/qualifying leaderboard gap is the best-lap difference to the fastest valid lap in that class; track lap counts cannot override it. Race gap remains time/laps behind the class leader based on track progress.

## 0.1.9

- Require sign-in before overlays display; save encrypted sessions across restarts and hide overlays on sign-out or failed account verification.
- Add VISIBLE beside each switch, aligned with overlay titles; increase settings row spacing and panel padding.
- Right-align leaderboard car numbers.
- Move Account beside the version number and UPDATES to the bottom of the left navigation.
- Includes player OUT, fixed PS Clubs gap characters, footer links and title-bar changes from 0.1.8.

## 0.1.8

- Use dedicated player pit-road and lap telemetry for the player OUT indicator, with pit-stall fallback when needed; preserve opponent detection.
- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.
- Remove the top-left title-bar wording from the main control panel.
- Add bottom-right Discord and Website buttons.

## 0.1.7

- Correct the contracting company in the installer and in-app terms to No Content Racing Division Inc.
- Update the Windows installer publisher and request acceptance of the corrected agreement.

## 0.1.6

- Improve account form contrast: readable checkbox labels and dark email/password fields. Includes all 0.1.5 updates below.

## 0.1.5

- Relative gaps use PS Clubs with tight signs and right alignment beside delta bars.
- Restore OUT detection after pit/garage frames with unavailable lap progress; retain the plugin-style yellow badge even with Stint hidden.
- Fuel headings enlarged 20%; LAPS IN RACE aligned with the second column.
- Independent Best Lap and Last Lap format selectors, preserving existing preferences.
- Green bottom-right window resize grip.
- Shared NCRD account sign-in, signup, email verification, password reset, Google/Discord, encrypted Remember me and linked installation management. Verified users no longer need an owner allowlist entry; explicitly disabled accounts remain blocked.
- Installer terms checkbox and versioned in-app acceptance for existing users; Terms available from the control panel.

# 0.1.4

- Add HOME, RELATIVE, LEADERBOARD and FUEL CALCULATOR navigation. Home has three synced visibility switches; each overlay has its own settings page.

- Remove the always-on-top explanatory line from the control panel and keep the control panel at normal window priority; only overlay windows stay topmost.

- Blend the main window and dialog title bars into their dark backgrounds; add matching minimise, maximise/restore and close buttons while retaining native drag and resize behaviour.
- Includes all 0.1.3 formatting, OUT badge, 2-pixel snapping and selectable lap-time format changes below.

# 0.1.3

- Match plugin header/footer typography and colour: PS Clubs, lavender #C8BEF5, with the original #28252F band background.

- Add a saved Leaderboard lap time format selector for both Best and Last: 00.0 or 00:00.0, with wider columns for minutes.

- Relative gaps use right-aligned PS Mono One, with signs directly adjacent to the numbers and no added spaces.
- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.
- Change overlay placement snapping to 2 physical pixels.
- Match the SimHub OUT badge: half-transparent yellow fill, yellow outline, dark centred text, rounded corners and the same dimensions as iRating boxes. Preserve the badge when Stint is hidden.

# 0.1.2

- Add Updates page: download, SHA-256 verification, restart, previous-version backup and startup-failure rollback.
- Check for available app releases at startup; use a separate GitHub app release channel.
- Rename the application NCRD Overlays; remove Standalone Beta and the tagline.
- Remove the tilde prefix from Relative gaps.
- Centre iRating digits horizontally and vertically inside their boxes on both overlays.

# 0.1.1 beta

- Fixed edit strip increasing overlay dimensions; keep window dimensions during drag, snap to a 10-pixel physical grid.
- Restored fastest-to-slowest class ordering, top three other-class rows, and player-class top three plus configurable context.
- Keep relative opponents visible without timing; use root SDK estimated lap pace; read lap times from live arrays, scalar player telemetry and session results.
- Restore white licence-coloured iRating boxes, 00.0 best/last laps, class-colour left strips, neutral/green/red right delta bars and compact SimHub-style bands.
- Add selectable Relative header/footer and Leaderboard header items, independent temperature units and visibility.
- Remove automatic status footers.
- Add optional estimated iRating gain/loss beside leaderboard iRating.
- Add supplied rabbit application, tray and installer icon.

Self-contained Windows x64 build. 25 fuel and 69 core regression checks passed. Windows desktop/iRacing acceptance remains to be run.

- Right-align leaderboard car numbers.
- Move Account beside the version number and UPDATES to the bottom of the left navigation.
- Includes player OUT, fixed PS Clubs gap characters, footer links and title-bar changes from 0.1.8.

## 0.1.8

- Use dedicated player pit-road and lap telemetry for the player OUT indicator, with pit-stall fallback when needed; preserve opponent detection.
- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.
- Remove the top-left title-bar wording from the main control panel.
- Add bottom-right Discord and Website buttons.

## 0.1.7

- Correct the contracting company in the installer and in-app terms to No Content Racing Division Inc.
- Update the Windows installer publisher and request acceptance of the corrected agreement.

## 0.1.6

- Improve account form contrast: readable checkbox labels and dark email/password fields. Includes all 0.1.5 updates below.

## 0.1.5

- Relative gaps use PS Clubs with tight signs and right alignment beside delta bars.
- Restore OUT detection after pit/garage frames with unavailable lap progress; retain the plugin-style yellow badge even with Stint hidden.
- Fuel headings enlarged 20%; LAPS IN RACE aligned with the second column.
- Independent Best Lap and Last Lap format selectors, preserving existing preferences.
- Green bottom-right window resize grip.
- Shared NCRD account sign-in, signup, email verification, password reset, Google/Discord, encrypted Remember me and linked installation management. Verified users no longer need an owner allowlist entry; explicitly disabled accounts remain blocked.
- Installer terms checkbox and versioned in-app acceptance for existing users; Terms available from the control panel.

# 0.1.4

- Add HOME, RELATIVE, LEADERBOARD and FUEL CALCULATOR navigation. Home has three synced visibility switches; each overlay has its own settings page.

- Remove the always-on-top explanatory line from the control panel and keep the control panel at normal window priority; only overlay windows stay topmost.

- Blend the main window and dialog title bars into their dark backgrounds; add matching minimise, maximise/restore and close buttons while retaining native drag and resize behaviour.
- Includes all 0.1.3 formatting, OUT badge, 2-pixel snapping and selectable lap-time format changes below.

# 0.1.3

- Match plugin header/footer typography and colour: PS Clubs, lavender #C8BEF5, with the original #28252F band background.

- Add a saved Leaderboard lap time format selector for both Best and Last: 00.0 or 00:00.0, with wider columns for minutes.

- Relative gaps use right-aligned PS Mono One, with signs directly adjacent to the numbers and no added spaces.
- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.
- Change overlay placement snapping to 2 physical pixels.
- Match the SimHub OUT badge: half-transparent yellow fill, yellow outline, dark centred text, rounded corners and the same dimensions as iRating boxes. Preserve the badge when Stint is hidden.

# 0.1.2

- Add Updates page: download, SHA-256 verification, restart, previous-version backup and startup-failure rollback.
- Check for available app releases at startup; use a separate GitHub app release channel.
- Rename the application NCRD Overlays; remove Standalone Beta and the tagline.
- Remove the tilde prefix from Relative gaps.
- Centre iRating digits horizontally and vertically inside their boxes on both overlays.

- Fixed edit strip increasing overlay dimensions; keep window dimensions during drag, snap to a 10-pixel physical grid.
- Restored fastest-to-slowest class ordering, top three other-class rows, and player-class top three plus configurable context.
- Keep relative opponents visible without timing; use root SDK estimated lap pace; read lap times from live arrays, scalar player telemetry and session results.
- Restore white licence-coloured iRating boxes, 00.0 best/last laps, class-colour left strips, neutral/green/red right delta bars and compact SimHub-style bands.
- Add selectable Relative header/footer and Leaderboard header items, independent temperature units and visibility.
- Remove automatic status footers.

name: NCRD Overlays 0.1.63
body:

Install the Setup EXE once. From 0.1.2 onward, use Updates > Download & restart. Settings are retained; the previous app version is kept for rollback.

The win-x64 ZIP is the verified in-app update payload. This release is separate from the SimHub plugin channel.

- Engineer: white rival session-fastest lap notifications with driver name and time; orange-yellow class leader / driver ahead / driver behind pit-entry alerts, each independently selectable. Duplicate leader/ahead notices are combined.

## 0.1.62
- Added Flagbox: rounded gradient flag blocks with individual flag switches, independent width/height (200 × 200 default), opacity and size controls. Highest-priority active flag wins; idle alerts hide automatically.

## 0.1.61
- Engineer lap times use title-sized PS Clubs, with ordinary-lap deltas underneath.
- Personal-best and session-fastest cards omit deltas.
- Left/Right notification alignment mirrors text, accent line and gradient; reflected in the settings preview.

## 0.1.60
- New Engineer popup overlay with colour-coded fuel, weather, track-wetness, penalty, repair and race-flag notifications.
- Configurable lap reports: every lap, personal best, session fastest or off; time and delta to prior best.
- Individual alert switches, duration, opacity and size controls; urgent messages take priority and idle overlay is invisible.

## 0.1.59
- Moved EXIT to the top right immediately after Account, removing it from the footer.

## 0.1.58
- Class driver count and SOF now sit directly beside the class name, with a consistent 12 px gap.

## 0.1.57
- Leaderboard driver-line selection moved into its main settings page with a rendered drag-and-drop order preview.
- Full name / first-initial name formatting with First Last / F. Last preview.
- Class headers show individual class SOF and a vector helmet beside driver count.
- Player class only aligned left; leaderboard header control renamed Header Items.

## 0.1.56
- Grouped Telemetry switches into rounded Graph and Misc panels, retaining the two-column layout.

## 0.1.55
- Optional NCRD-green gradient flashes behind the gear on shifts, fading over 450 ms.
- Gradient follows gear size and element order, respects background opacity, and does not trigger on initial connection.

## 0.1.54
- Added adjustable gear size. New wheel size defaults to 100 px and input meters to 20 px; existing saved sizes are preserved.
- Replaced ordering buttons with a rendered drag-and-drop telemetry layout preview, insertion highlight and keyboard reordering.

## 0.1.53
- Reserved right-hand spacing on all settings pages so scrollbars remain clear of controls.

## 0.1.52
- Optional redline gear blink uses the car shift-light RPM threshold.
- Optional gear indicator and configurable left-to-right element ordering.
- Separate wheel size and input meter width controls for Telemetry.
- New detailed GT wheel vector with open grips, display cutout, button and rotary details.
- Layout reserves space for the selected sizes without changing graph time scale.

## 0.1.51
- Telemetry: individual throttle, brake, steering and blue clutch graph toggles; removed graph legend.
- Width control extends visible history at a consistent time scale; adjustable graph thickness and opacity retained.
- Optional original GT or Round steering wheel follows actual steering angle.

## 0.1.50
- Add a Telemetry overlay and settings tab with 5–60 seconds of history, background opacity, 1–6 px line thickness and optional vertical throttle/brake/clutch meters.
- Throttle is green, brakes red, steering white at 30% opacity, and recorded ABS-active brake segments yellow. Live input history is bounded and clears on telemetry resets.
- Telemetry shares the existing visibility, locking, layout persistence and global shortcuts; enable it from Home.

## 0.1.49
- Give action buttons and their hover highlights the same rounded corners as menu buttons, consistently in both themes.

## 0.1.48
- Left-align the rendered logo with the sidebar and status text in both themes instead of centring it inside the image area.

## 0.1.47
- Align Demo mode, Unlock Overlays and Reset positions together at the far right of the top toolbar, in that order.

## 0.1.46
- Move the Auto / Force show / Force hide dropdown from the top toolbar to General Settings.

## 0.1.45
- Use white app menu labels and headings with neutral-grey PS Mono subtitles. Paper uses dark text for contrast. Overlay telemetry colours are unchanged.

## 0.1.44
- Redesign sliders with wide rounded tracks, rounded green handles and labels above the track with right-aligned value badges.

## 0.1.43
- Give selected sidebar tabs a subtle green gradient and illuminated edge, with a matching selection treatment in dropdown menus for both themes.

## 0.1.42
- Setting Background Saturation and Line Divider Style to zero now produces one continuous dark-grey background across headers, footers and all driver rows.
- Apply Background Saturation to leaderboard class-header backgrounds as well as the main header, footer and driver-row backgrounds. Class-label colours stay unchanged.

## 0.1.41
- Give slider knobs the NCRD green accent in both themes.
- Use consistent on/off pill switches for all checkbox options, including overlay settings, Demo mode, temperature units and password visibility.

## 0.1.40
- Move keyboard shortcuts into Settings with click-to-assign controls, conflict detection and saved custom assignments. Existing shortcuts remain the defaults.
- Remove keyboard shortcut and borderless/windowed-mode notes from the footer.

## 0.1.39
- Align the app toolbar, sidebar, page panels, settings controls and footer with consistent spacing. Home now uses the same panel style as every settings tab.
- Move the Dark / Paper theme selector to General Settings.

## 0.1.38
- Apply background opacity uniformly to headers, footers, driver rows, class bands, pit details and fuel warning backgrounds. Text, icons and indicators remain fully legible.

## 0.1.37
- Add Line Divider Style and Background Saturation sliders for Relative and Leaderboard, saved independently.
- Blend from a solid driver-row background to alternating row tones, and from dark neutral grey to the existing purple tint.
- Preserve driver text, flags, class colours and player highlighting. Defaults retain the existing appearance.
- Replace Lamborghini's bull-only mark with a full white shield vector on transparent background.

- Add a LOCK OVERLAYS button inside each green edit bar; clicking any one locks every overlay.

- Includes saved-position protection from automatic window recovery.

- Includes spectator iRating fix, centred leaderboard headings and white McLaren speedmark.

- Includes live spectator iRating estimate fix and centred leaderboard column titles.

- Add regression checks for extra unclassified entries, missing/duplicate positions, and parsed official live races.

- Examples: 4751 / 4789 -> 4.7K; 4790 -> 4.8K. Full ratings remain exact.

- Full ratings remain the default. Compact values retain licence colours and centred boxes.

- Hover tint preserves the selected menu state and blue update-available indicator.

## 0.1.22

- Choose Header (default), Footer or Off in Fuel Calculator settings; selection is saved.
- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.
- Reserve banner space to keep overlay dimensions and data positions stable as alerts change.

## 0.1.21

- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

- Distinguish actual black-flag penalties with a white X over the black rectangle on both driver overlays. Slowdown/furled warnings remain a plain black rectangle in Relative; an actual penalty takes precedence if both flags are present.
- Includes restored TRACK / AIR text and plain C/F units.

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.
- Includes the restored TRACK / AIR labels with plain C/F units from 0.1.16.

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

- Replace TRACK and AIR text in overlay header/footer bands with the supplied road and sun graphics, tinted lavender. Keep icon/value pairs aligned together in each slot.
- Remove degree symbols from temperature values: 25.0C / 77.0F.
- Includes the race-only pit lap/time row extensions from 0.1.14.

- Default Last 5 to off for new settings; preserve saved row choices.
- Use spring green for Last and lavender for Last 5.

- Use the standalone white McLaren speedmark, with no wordmark or background.

- Full ratings remain the default. Compact values retain licence colours and centred boxes.

## 0.1.23
- Subtle hover highlights on sidebar menu items and app buttons in Dark and Paper.
- Hover tint preserves the selected menu state and blue update-available indicator.

## 0.1.22
- Replace the fuel calculator PIT badge with a full-width PIT banner.
- Choose Header (default), Footer or Off in Fuel Calculator settings; selection is saved.
- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.
- Reserve banner space to keep overlay dimensions and data positions stable as alerts change.

## 0.1.21

- Add a saved Dark / Paper app-theme dropdown beside Account. Paper uses light-grey surfaces, charcoal typography, square cards and thin borders inspired by the supplied reference.
- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Rebuild the app, tray and installer icon from the original transparent rabbit artwork; remove the opaque white square at all packaged icon sizes.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

## 0.1.19

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.

## 0.1.16

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

- Move Account beside the version number and UPDATES to the bottom of the left navigation.
- Includes player OUT, fixed PS Clubs gap characters, footer links and title-bar changes from 0.1.8.

## 0.1.8

- Use dedicated player pit-road and lap telemetry for the player OUT indicator, with pit-stall fallback when needed; preserve opponent detection.
- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.
- Remove the top-left title-bar wording from the main control panel.
- Add bottom-right Discord and Website buttons.

## 0.1.7

- Correct the contracting company in the installer and in-app terms to No Content Racing Division Inc.
- Update the Windows installer publisher and request acceptance of the corrected agreement.

## 0.1.6

- Improve account form contrast: readable checkbox labels and dark email/password fields. Includes all 0.1.5 updates below.

## 0.1.5

- Remove the always-on-top explanatory line from the control panel and keep the control panel at normal window priority; only overlay windows stay topmost.

- Blend the main window and dialog title bars into their dark backgrounds; add matching minimise, maximise/restore and close buttons while retaining native drag and resize behaviour.

# 0.1.3

- Match plugin header/footer typography and colour: PS Clubs, lavender #C8BEF5, with the original #28252F band background.

- Add a saved Leaderboard lap time format selector for both Best and Last: 00.0 or 00:00.0, with wider columns for minutes.

- Relative gaps use right-aligned PS Mono One, with signs directly adjacent to the numbers and no added spaces.
- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.
- Change overlay placement snapping to 2 physical pixels.

- Width control extends visible history at a consistent time scale; adjustable graph thickness and opacity retained.
- Optional original GT or Round steering wheel follows actual steering angle.

- Add a Telemetry overlay and settings tab with 5–60 seconds of history, background opacity, 1–6 px line thickness and optional vertical throttle/brake/clutch meters.

## 0.1.49
- Give action buttons and their hover highlights the same rounded corners as menu buttons, consistently in both themes.

## 0.1.48
- Left-align the rendered logo with the sidebar and status text in both themes instead of centring it inside the image area.

## 0.1.47
- Align Demo mode, Unlock Overlays and Reset positions together at the far right of the top toolbar, in that order.

## 0.1.46
- Move the Auto / Force show / Force hide dropdown from the top toolbar to General Settings.

## 0.1.45
- Use white app menu labels and headings with neutral-grey PS Mono subtitles. Paper uses dark text for contrast. Overlay telemetry colours are unchanged.

## 0.1.44
- Redesign sliders with wide rounded tracks, rounded green handles and labels above the track with right-aligned value badges.

## 0.1.43
- Give selected sidebar tabs a subtle green gradient and illuminated edge, with a matching selection treatment in dropdown menus for both themes.

## 0.1.42
- Setting Background Saturation and Line Divider Style to zero now produces one continuous dark-grey background across headers, footers and all driver rows.
- Apply Background Saturation to leaderboard class-header backgrounds as well as the main header, footer and driver-row backgrounds. Class-label colours stay unchanged.

## 0.1.41
- Give slider knobs the NCRD green accent in both themes.
- Use consistent on/off pill switches for all checkbox options, including overlay settings, Demo mode, temperature units and password visibility.

## 0.1.40
- Move keyboard shortcuts into Settings with click-to-assign controls, conflict detection and saved custom assignments. Existing shortcuts remain the defaults.
- Remove keyboard shortcut and borderless/windowed-mode notes from the footer.

## 0.1.39
- Align the app toolbar, sidebar, page panels, settings controls and footer with consistent spacing. Home now uses the same panel style as every settings tab.
- Move the Dark / Paper theme selector to General Settings.

## 0.1.38
- Apply background opacity uniformly to headers, footers, driver rows, class bands, pit details and fuel warning backgrounds. Text, icons and indicators remain fully legible.

## 0.1.37
- Add Line Divider Style and Background Saturation sliders for Relative and Leaderboard, saved independently.
- Blend from a solid driver-row background to alternating row tones, and from dark neutral grey to the existing purple tint.
- Preserve driver text, flags, class colours and player highlighting. Defaults retain the existing appearance.
- Replace Lamborghini's bull-only mark with a full white shield vector on transparent background.

## 0.1.36
- Add a general SETTINGS page directly above UPDATES in the left menu.
- First setting: Keep overlays visible outside the cockpit. Enabled by default to preserve spectator visibility.

- Save the preference across restarts and updates; match Dark and Paper themes.

## 0.1.35
- Add Auto / Force show / Force hide overlay visibility modes in the control panel and tray menu.
- Global Ctrl+Alt+H toggles force show/hide, including while the control panel is hidden.
- Force show overrides simulator-disconnect hiding while respecting per-overlay switches and sign-in access. Auto is restored on app launch.
- Includes edit-bar LOCK OVERLAYS buttons and saved-position protection.

## 0.1.34
- Add a LOCK OVERLAYS button inside each green edit bar; clicking any one locks every overlay.
- Button scales with the overlay and does not change its dimensions or placement.
- Includes saved-position protection from automatic window recovery.

## 0.1.33
- Prevent automatic window relocation and off-screen recovery from overwriting saved overlay positions.
- Restore saved positions whenever overlays reappear; only intentional dragging or Reset positions changes the saved layout.
- Check screen visibility using native monitor coordinates, avoiding mixed display-scaling comparisons.
- Add Fuel Calculator position reload, reconnect and temporary off-screen recovery checks.

## 0.1.32
- Yellow fuel banner counts down as available fuel crosses each whole-lap threshold.
- Uses the live average fuel estimate: 4.9 laps displays 5 LAPS OF FUEL; 4.0 displays 4 LAPS OF FUEL.
- Below one lap it switches to PIT on red, in either header or footer placement.

## 0.1.31
- Yellow low-fuel banner reads 5 LAPS OF FUEL below five laps remaining.
- Critical banner reads PIT on red below one lap remaining.
- Applies to either Header or Footer placement; Off still suppresses notifications.

## 0.1.30
- Hide all overlays automatically when the simulator disconnects; restore enabled overlays when telemetry reconnects.
- Preserve visibility preferences and keep the control panel accessible. Demo mode continues to display previews.
- Restore leaderboard column headings to their previous left alignment.

## 0.1.29
- Session lap headers update from the overall leader while spectating, rather than a frozen local-driver lap counter.
- Keep the local lap display when driving and cap spectator laps at the race distance.
- Includes spectator iRating fix, centred leaderboard headings and white McLaren speedmark.

## 0.1.28
- Use the standalone white McLaren speedmark, with no wordmark or background.
- Includes live spectator iRating estimate fix and centred leaderboard column titles.

## 0.1.27
- Fix iRating estimates being disabled while spectating an official live race with replay playback active.
- Use session mode to distinguish live-server playback from saved replays; saved replay estimates remain disabled even when paused.
- Centre leaderboard column titles above their columns.

## 0.1.26
- Fix iRating estimates disappearing for a whole class when the session roster includes unclassified cars with no race position.
- Keep classified retired/disconnected drivers in the projection and validate the ranked field before calculating.
- Add regression checks for extra unclassified entries, missing/duplicate positions, and parsed official live races.

## 0.1.25
- Compact iRating rounds down to tenths of a K, except within 10 points of the next hundred.
- Examples: 4751 / 4789 -> 4.7K; 4790 -> 4.8K. Full ratings remain exact.

## 0.1.24
- Independent iRating format selectors for Relative and Leaderboard: 0000 or 0.0K.
- Full ratings remain the default. Compact values retain licence colours and centred boxes.

## 0.1.23
- Subtle hover highlights on sidebar menu items and app buttons in Dark and Paper.
- Hover tint preserves the selected menu state and blue update-available indicator.

## 0.1.22
- Replace the fuel calculator PIT badge with a full-width PIT banner.
- Choose Header (default), Footer or Off in Fuel Calculator settings; selection is saved.
- Yellow below 5 laps of fuel, red below 1 lap; works even with Summary hidden.
- Reserve banner space to keep overlay dimensions and data positions stable as alerts change.

## 0.1.21

- Add a saved Dark / Paper app-theme dropdown beside Account. Paper uses light-grey surfaces, charcoal typography, square cards and thin borders inspired by the supplied reference.
- Switch app chrome and dialogs instantly, including the logo, controls and title bar; keep racing overlay styling and the blue update alert independent.
- Includes transparent app icon, revised flag badges and restored temperature labels.

## 0.1.20

- Rebuild the app, tray and installer icon from the original transparent rabbit artwork; remove the opaque white square at all packaged icon sizes.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X penalty flags, traditional black/orange meatball flags, and restored TRACK / AIR labels.

## 0.1.19

- Render meatball flags as a black rectangle with an orange circle on both overlays.
- Includes plain black slowdown warnings in Relative, white-X black-flag penalties, and restored TRACK / AIR text with plain C/F units.

## 0.1.18

- Distinguish actual black-flag penalties with a white X over the black rectangle on both driver overlays. Slowdown/furled warnings remain a plain black rectangle in Relative; an actual penalty takes precedence if both flags are present.
- Includes restored TRACK / AIR text and plain C/F units.

## 0.1.17

- Show slowdown/furled-black warnings as the existing black flag rectangle beside driver names in Relative. Clear the badge when telemetry clears the warning; keep meatball indicators independent.
- Includes the restored TRACK / AIR labels with plain C/F units from 0.1.16.

## 0.1.16

- Restore TRACK and AIR text labels in overlay header/footer bands, retaining lavender styling and C/F units without degree symbols.

## 0.1.15

- Replace TRACK and AIR text in overlay header/footer bands with the supplied road and sun graphics, tinted lavender. Keep icon/value pairs aligned together in each slot.
- Remove degree symbols from temperature values: 25.0C / 77.0F.
- Includes the race-only pit lap/time row extensions from 0.1.14.

## 0.1.14

- Add race-only pit details extending from the right of each applicable leaderboard row: pit-entry lap (L12) and total pit-lane time (00:34.7). Time runs while in pit lane and freezes on exit; the latest stop remains until the next stop/session reset.
- Keep the extension transparent for other rows and remove its width completely when no displayed driver has a recorded stop. Add a Pit stop details visibility option.
- Record only observed pit entries after the race starts; do not fabricate stops for mid-pit joins, pre-race staging or missing telemetry.

## 0.1.13

- Reduce all fuel calculator numeric values and the Next Pit timer by 10%, keeping title sizes and character spacing proportions.

- Highlight the sidebar UPDATES button in blue with white text when startup or manual update checks find a newer app release. Restore normal styling when a successful check reports up to date; failed checks preserve the last known state.

## 0.1.12

- Add an optional white manufacturer-logo column immediately after position changes on the leaderboard, including existing layouts. Driver line items can hide or reorder it.
- Identify makes from each car’s SDK path/name, with a short label fallback for makes without bundled artwork and a dash for unknown cars.
- Includes the fuel spacing, default Last 5 visibility and row colours from 0.1.11.

## 0.1.11

- Slightly increase character spacing on all fuel calculator values, retaining PS Clubs and keeping long values within their columns.
- Default Last 5 to off for new settings; preserve saved row choices.
- Use spring green for Last and lavender for Last 5.

## 0.1.10

- Remember terms acceptance across restarts and updates, including earlier accepted terms. Fresh interactive installer acceptance is recognized by the app; silent installs still require in-app acceptance.
- Keep the sign-in/signup dialog open until authenticated, with an explicit Exit NCRD action; show it again after sign-out or account revocation. Saved valid sessions still restore automatically.
- Practice/qualifying leaderboard gap is the best-lap difference to the fastest valid lap in that class; track lap counts cannot override it. Race gap remains time/laps behind the class leader based on track progress.

## 0.1.9

- Require sign-in before overlays display; save encrypted sessions across restarts and hide overlays on sign-out or failed account verification.
- Add VISIBLE beside each switch, aligned with overlay titles; increase settings row spacing and panel padding.
- Right-align leaderboard car numbers.
- Move Account beside the version number and UPDATES to the bottom of the left navigation.
- Includes player OUT, fixed PS Clubs gap characters, footer links and title-bar changes from 0.1.8.

## 0.1.8

- Use dedicated player pit-road and lap telemetry for the player OUT indicator, with pit-stall fallback when needed; preserve opponent detection.
- Render PS Clubs relative gaps in fixed digit/sign cells with a fixed decimal position, right aligned beside the delta bars.
- Remove the top-left title-bar wording from the main control panel.
- Add bottom-right Discord and Website buttons.

## 0.1.7

- Correct the contracting company in the installer and in-app terms to No Content Racing Division Inc.
- Update the Windows installer publisher and request acceptance of the corrected agreement.

## 0.1.6

- Improve account form contrast: readable checkbox labels and dark email/password fields. Includes all 0.1.5 updates below.

## 0.1.5

- Relative gaps use PS Clubs with tight signs and right alignment beside delta bars.
- Restore OUT detection after pit/garage frames with unavailable lap progress; retain the plugin-style yellow badge even with Stint hidden.
- Fuel headings enlarged 20%; LAPS IN RACE aligned with the second column.
- Independent Best Lap and Last Lap format selectors, preserving existing preferences.
- Green bottom-right window resize grip.
- Shared NCRD account sign-in, signup, email verification, password reset, Google/Discord, encrypted Remember me and linked installation management. Verified users no longer need an owner allowlist entry; explicitly disabled accounts remain blocked.
- Installer terms checkbox and versioned in-app acceptance for existing users; Terms available from the control panel.

# 0.1.4

- Add HOME, RELATIVE, LEADERBOARD and FUEL CALCULATOR navigation. Home has three synced visibility switches; each overlay has its own settings page.

- Remove the always-on-top explanatory line from the control panel and keep the control panel at normal window priority; only overlay windows stay topmost.

- Blend the main window and dialog title bars into their dark backgrounds; add matching minimise, maximise/restore and close buttons while retaining native drag and resize behaviour.
- Includes all 0.1.3 formatting, OUT badge, 2-pixel snapping and selectable lap-time format changes below.

# 0.1.3

- Match plugin header/footer typography and colour: PS Clubs, lavender #C8BEF5, with the original #28252F band background.

- Add a saved Leaderboard lap time format selector for both Best and Last: 00.0 or 00:00.0, with wider columns for minutes.

- Relative gaps use right-aligned PS Mono One, with signs directly adjacent to the numbers and no added spaces.
- Anchor the Relative gap to the right edge, 3 logical pixels before the delta bar.
- Change overlay placement snapping to 2 physical pixels.
- Match the SimHub OUT badge: half-transparent yellow fill, yellow outline, dark centred text, rounded corners and the same dimensions as iRating boxes. Preserve the badge when Stint is hidden.

# 0.1.2

- Add Updates page: download, SHA-256 verification, restart, previous-version backup and startup-failure rollback.
- Check for available app releases at startup; use a separate GitHub app release channel.
- Rename the application NCRD Overlays; remove Standalone Beta and the tagline.
- Remove the tilde prefix from Relative gaps.
- Centre iRating digits horizontally and vertically inside their boxes on both overlays.

# 0.1.1 beta

- Fixed edit strip increasing overlay dimensions; keep window dimensions during drag, snap to a 10-pixel physical grid.
- Restored fastest-to-slowest class ordering, top three other-class rows, and player-class top three plus configurable context.
- Keep relative opponents visible without timing; use root SDK estimated lap pace; read lap times from live arrays, scalar player telemetry and session results.
- Restore white licence-coloured iRating boxes, 00.0 best/last laps, class-colour left strips, neutral/green/red right delta bars and compact SimHub-style bands.
- Add selectable Relative header/footer and Leaderboard header items, independent temperature units and visibility.
- Remove automatic status footers.
- Add optional estimated iRating gain/loss beside leaderboard iRating.
- Add supplied rabbit application, tray and installer icon.

Self-contained Windows x64 build. 25 fuel and 69 core regression checks passed. Windows desktop/iRacing acceptance remains to be run.

## 0.1.57
- Leaderboard driver-line selection moved into its main settings page with a rendered drag-and-drop order preview.
- Full name / first-initial name formatting with First Last / F. Last preview.
- Class headers show individual class SOF and a vector helmet beside driver count.

## 0.1.56
- Grouped Telemetry switches into rounded Graph and Misc panels, retaining the two-column layout.

## 0.1.55
